claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.mode.filtered_spell_list_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's main success path is not a named granted spell. It lets the bearer choose any Wizard spell they do not know, constrained by class list, castable level, and material-cost ceiling, then cast that chosen spell using normal spell parameters.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast, and it can't have Material components costing more than 1,000 GP."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: branch_contingent_cooldown_consumption
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The hat's once-per-rest lockout applies only on a successful Arcana check, while the spell slot is spent before the check. Current activation mechanics consume the declared resource at activation time and cannot represent a success-only cooldown honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Once you decide on the spell, you must expend a spell slot of the spell's level. Then, to determine whether you cast the spell, make an Intelligence (Arcana) check... On a successful check, you cast the spell ... and you can't use this property again until you finish a Short or Long Rest."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.delegated_spell_casting_time
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's activation cost is not fixed on the item. It inherits the casting time of the chosen spell, which the current activation surface cannot express.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spellcasting_focus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive focus property is a deterministic item rule affecting component substitution for Wizard spells. The current passive effect atoms do not model 'can be used as a spellcasting focus' at all.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding the hat, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells."
